thread:
Sam: FYI POC with Nimbus Health stuck on streaming behind their corp proxy. Non-streaming APIs ok. Logs: ECONNRESET after initial frames.
Priya: Did they set NO_PROXY? wildcards sometimes fail.
Sam: They set NO_PROXY=*.redwood.internal,localhost. Curl with --noproxy works. SDK still routes via proxy for streams.
Jorge: We saw this before: streaming path used low-level socket and skipped NO_PROXY parsing. Patch exists but not released.
Tyler: Quick workaround: add exact stream hostname to NO_PROXY (no wildcard) and restart app.
Sam: They tried that and stream worked. Need hotfix + short security blurb for their infosec.
Priya: I'll draft blurb explaining env-var semantics, no creds leaked, and our hotfix timeline.
Jorge: I'll prepare a patched wheel and minimal install steps.
ops-bot: POC NimbusHealth: proxy bypass triaged, workaround confirmed, hotfix + sec-blurb pending (owners: Jorge/Priya).
